solutions.latex: $I = \dfrac{C\sin\phi}{r^2}$. $\ r^2 = h^2 + a^2$, $\ \sin\phi = \dfrac{h}{r} = \dfrac{h}{\sqrt{h^2+a^2}}$. $$I = C\left(\dfrac{h}{\sqrt{h^2+a^2}}\right)\left(\dfrac{1}{h^2+a^2}\right) = Ch(h^2+a^2)^{-\frac{3}{2}}$$ $$\dfrac{dI}{dh} = C(h^2+a^2)^{-\frac{3}{2}} + C\left(-\dfrac{3}{2}\right)(2h)(h^2+a^2)^{-\frac{5}{2}}h = C(h^2+a^2)^{-\frac{5}{2}}\left[(h^2+a^2) - 3h^2\right] = C(h^2+a^2)^{-\frac{5}{2}}(a^2 - 2h^2)$$ When $\dfrac{dI}{dh} = 0$: $a^2 - 2h^2 = 0$, $h^2 = \dfrac{a^2}{2}$, $h = \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}a$ (reject $h = -\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}a$). When $h = \dfrac{1}{2}a$: $\dfrac{dI}{dh} = C\left(\left(\dfrac{a}{2}\right)^2 + a^2\right)^{-\frac{5}{2}}\left(a^2 - 2\left(\dfrac{a}{2}\right)^2\right) = C\left(\dfrac{5}{4}a^2\right)^{-\frac{5}{2}}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}a^2\right) > 0$. When $h = a$: $\dfrac{dI}{dh} = C(a^2+a^2)^{-\frac{5}{2}}(a^2 - 2a^2) < 0$. $\therefore$ When $h = \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}a$, the intensity $I$ is maximised.

$$\int_{-\log_3 b}^{0} \left(-3^{-x} + b\right)dx = \dfrac{1}{\ln 3}$$ $$\text{LHS} = \left[\dfrac{3^{-x}}{\ln 3} + bx\right]_{-\log_3 b}^{0} = \left(\dfrac{3^0}{\ln 3} + 0\right) - \left(\dfrac{3^{\log_3 b}}{\ln 3} - b\log_3 b\right) = \dfrac{1}{\ln 3} - \dfrac{b}{\ln 3} + b\log_3 b$$ LHS = RHS: $\dfrac{1}{\ln 3} - \dfrac{b}{\ln 3} + b\log_3 b = \dfrac{1}{\ln 3}$, $\ -\dfrac{b}{\ln 3} + b\log_3 b = 0$, $\ b\log_3 b = \dfrac{b}{\ln 3}$. $b \ne 0$: $\log_3 b = \dfrac{1}{\ln 3}$, $\ \dfrac{\ln b}{\ln 3} = \dfrac{1}{\ln 3}$, $\ \ln b = 1$, $\ b = e$.
